title: RollCall #4
summary: This is a call to discuss a frameworks to help aid with coordination between the various EVM-like L2s. The idea is to establish **optional** norms and standards for L2s to be able to extend the EVM and related tooling while limiting conflicts with the L1 EVM and preventing a proliferation of mutually incompatible standards among the L2s. ## Meeting Info - ~~Wed Mar 13~~ [Wed Apr 10, 2024, 14:00-15:30 UTC](https://sav
